Context: it is Bhai Dooj and Myra props the phone on the sofa and does roli tilak on the screen while Shruti keeps calling numbers and Tanya cuts Myra's ticket for her. Ending: the brother shouts "Didi, 45! Cut karo!" because he was watching her ticket, and Myra wins Early Five.
ideas.format: Festival moment inside Housie
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Bhai Dooj 11 Nov (hindutone.com) + LEARNINGS: start on a game in progress

Context: memory lane theme, Tanya, Ruhi and Myra squeeze onto the same sofa in the same positions, Tanya's old saree no longer drapes so she wraps it over her suit. Ending: the old and new photos side by side, everyone changed except the host's sofa cover.
ideas.format: Then vs now reveal
ideas.source: Trend: Memory lane kitty (momjunction.com) + Expectation vs reality split (socialketchup.in)

ideas.idea: Hook: Tanya unrolls paper sashes: "Aaj Kitty Awards! Pehla award: Sabse Late!" Context: every award (Phone pe busy, Hisaab Queen, Main kuch sweet laaungi) gets the whole room pointing at one lady, and Myra walks in mid-ceremony to collect Sabse Late. ideas.format: Award show
ideas.source: Trend: Runway and award sashes (momjunction.com)

ideas.idea: Diwali chitr Housie: tickets carry 15 small Diwali drawings instead of numbers (diya, ladoo, phuljhadi, rangoli, kandeel, Lakshmi coin, kaju katli) from a printed sheet of 30. The host pulls picture chits and calls them out. Twist: every fifth chit is acted out by the host without speaking, and anyone who cuts the wrong picture loses her last cut.
ideas.format: Housie with a twist
ideas.source: Trend: Symbol Housie (republicworld.com) + our Housie winner (KG-2026-10-22-c 1161 views)

ideas.idea: Bhai Dooj tilak: in pairs, one lady plays the bhai and the other is blindfolded with a roli plate and a few rice grains. In 1 minute she must put a tilak and stick 3 grains on the bhai's forehead. Twist: the bhai holds a whole ladoo in her mouth and must not laugh; if any crumb falls the pair is out. Closest-to-centre tilak wins.
ideas.format: One-minute pair game
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Bhai Dooj 11 Nov (hindutone.com) + one-minute game demos

ideas.idea: Bachpan photo pehchano: a week before, every lady sends the host one childhood photo. On the day the host shows them on a phone or printouts one by one and everyone writes who it is. Twist: the lady in the photo must also write a guess, and if she fools the room by guessing someone else she gets double points.
ideas.format: Guess game
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Children's Day 14 Nov (hindutone.com) + Memory lane kitty (momjunction.com)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie in progress, Shruti calls "Number 8, Diwali ki date!" and Ruhi drops her pen: "Diwali kitty mein saree ya lehenga?" Context: Tanya and Myra take sides and the three argue in quick turns (saree: 'classic', lehenga: 'photo mein achha', saree: 'khana kaise khaogi'), while Shruti keeps calling numbers nobody cuts. Ending: Shruti claims Full House alone and points at her own nightsuit: "Main toh yahi pehen ke aaungi."
ideas.format: Debate inside Housie
ideas.source: Trend: Multi-character debate (fluxnote.io) + Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov + LEARNINGS: open on a game in progress

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie in progress, Myra has a duster still tucked in her waist and taps her watch: "Sirf ek ghanta, phir Diwali ki safai." Context: every time she gets up to leave, Tanya or Ruhi hands her a fresh ticket, "Bas ek aur game", and the wall clock jumps an hour each time. Ending: her phone pings, a photo from her husband of the shining living room: "Safai ho gayi. Aaram se khelo." and Myra sits back down and cuts a number.
ideas.format: Me-time payoff
ideas.source: Trend: Her own time message (our reel, 57 shares) + Overachiever Diwali safai + Diwali 7 days away

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie in progress, Ruhi cuts a number and announces: "Agli kitty skip, Chhath pe Patna ja rahi hoon." Context: Shruti opens the hisaab register to move her turn, and Tanya and Myra instantly place thekua orders with her ("Mere liye do dabbe!"), the order list getting longer than the hisaab. Ending: next kitty, Ruhi on video call from the ghat at sunrise while the doorbell rings at the host's house: a courier with one big box of thekua, every name written on top.
ideas.format: Festival call from home
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Chhath 15 Nov (hindutone.com) + Video call Tambola

ideas.idea: Ek minute ki dulhan: pairs, one lady sits still as the bride and her partner has 1 minute to dress her from a shared tray of household things (dupatta for ghoonghat, bindi packet, bangles, a marigold or paper garland, kajal, a clutch). Twist: the tray also holds decoys (clothes peg, steel katori, TV remote, tea strainer) and at 30 seconds the host shouts "Rishta badlo!" and every dresser moves one bride to the left and finishes her look. Room votes the best bride with raised spoons. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: One-minute makeover race
ideas.source: Trend: One-minute makeover game (Roop ki rani reel, 646 likes, 18 comments)

ideas.idea: Kitty ki adaalat: the host reads a kitty 'crime' from a chit (same saree third time, 'main kuch sweet laaungi' every month, phone on during Housie). Two random ladies argue for and against for 30 seconds each, and the room gives the verdict by raising spoons. Twist: halfway through the host bangs a belan and shouts "Palti!" and both must swap sides mid-sentence; whoever stumbles pays a forfeit of one song. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, only chits and a belan.
ideas.format: Debate game
ideas.source: Trend: Multi-character debate (fluxnote.io)

ideas.idea: Ghat ka diya: a parat or big tub of water on the floor is the ghat, and each team gets a paper boat carrying an LED tealight and a straw. Relay: one by one each lady must blow the boat from one end to the other through the straw, then hand the straw on. Twist: the opposite team gets one 'hawa' card to blow back against the boat for 5 seconds, and if the diya tips into the water the team restarts. LED only, no flames. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Team relay
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Chhath 15 Nov + Dev Diwali 24 Nov (hindutone.com)

Context: the calls carry on in peace until a loud ringtone plays from inside Tanya's own pallu, "Beta ka call hai, important hai." Ending: Ruhi silently holds the basket out to Tanya, and Tanya drops her phone in on top of everyone else's.

ideas.source: Trend: Admin breaks her own rule (our dress code admin reel, 4938 views, skip 25.6%)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie in progress, Shruti opens the kitty calendar on her phone: "Agli kitty 22 November?" Context: Ruhi and Myra scroll their WhatsApp and hold up shaadi card after shaadi card for every date she suggests (Tulsi Vivah ke baad sab ki shaadiyan). Ending: the only free slot is a Tuesday at 11 am, and all three cut a number and shout "Done!" while the calendar fills with pink shaadi dots.
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom with phone calendar and shaadi card screens
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Dev Uthani 20 Nov + Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov opens shaadi season (hindutone.com)

ideas.idea: Hook: the first kitty after Diwali, Housie running, Myra pushes the samosa plate away: "Diwali ke baad diet!" and Tanya and Ruhi nod, "Haan, main bhi." Context: on every called number one of them quietly takes "bas ek" kaju katli from the leftover Diwali box. Ending: the host lifts the lid to serve and the box is empty; all three point at each other with crumbs on their sarees.
ideas.format: Living-room sitcom, opens on the game
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (post-Diwali kitty) + Expectation vs reality split

ideas.idea: Shaadi ka suitcase: pairs get one small bag or suitcase and a shared centre table with 12 household things (folded saree, bangle box, hair dryer, chappal pair, charger, dupatta, makeup pouch, shawl, steel tiffin, slippers, perfume, mithai box). In 60 seconds one lady hands and the other packs, then they must zip it shut. Twist: at 30 seconds the host reads a husband's text "Mera kurta bhi rakh lena" and every pair must fit one more item or lose. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Pairs race, top-down
ideas.source: Trend: Pack in 60 seconds (partystuff.in) + shaadi season

ideas.idea: Shagun ka lifafa: each lady gets 3 envelopes, a stack of play notes (10, 20, 50, 100, 500) and a few Re 1 coins. The host calls a relation and an amount ("Bua ki beti, 1100", "Padosi ka beta, 501") and the first lady to hold up a sealed envelope with the exact amount wins the round. Twist: every shagun must end in 1, so if you forget the Re 1 coin your envelope is 'kanjoos' and you lose a point. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Speed round, everyone plays at once
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Dev Uthani 20 Nov + Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov opens shaadi season (hindutone.com)

ideas.idea: Mehendi mein naam dhoondo: before the kitty the host draws a big mehendi-style pattern on chart paper and hides every lady's name in the swirls, like a bride hides the dulha's name. On the day the sheet goes on the table and everyone has 2 minutes to find and circle her own name. Twist: the last lady to find hers becomes the dulha and must do a 10-second baraat entry to a dhol beat from a phone. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Search race on one big sheet
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi season kitty + Festival window: Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov

ideas.idea: Hook: doorbell, Ruhi blocks her doorway in a nightsuit and shawl holding the kitty pot: "Aaj Pajama kitty! Saree mein aayi toh entry nahi!" Context: each ring brings one guest who half-follows the rule (Shruti in pajamas with full bridal makeup, Myra in a saree with pajama hems peeking out, Tanya in a nightsuit plus heels), chip 'PAJAMA SCORE' changing every shot. Ending: the group photo timer starts and Ruhi whips off her shawl to show a silk saree underneath, and the three guests throw her own line back: "Saree mein aayi toh entry nahi!"
ideas.format: Door-arrivals (one guest per ring, score chip, host breaks her own rule)
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty (thebash.com) + Admin breaks her own rule (our KG-2026-10-27-c, 4938 views, skip 25.6%)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti slams the hisaab register on the table: "Diwali ke chakkar mein teen logon ki kitty pending hai!" chip 'PENDING: Rs 6,000'. Context: on each called number one lady gives her excuse (Tanya: "Bonus abhi aaya nahi", Myra: "Dhanteras pe sikka le liya", Ruhi: "Gifts mein chala gaya") and the chip drops as each one pays up with a sigh. Ending: Ruhi grabs the register to check the total and reads the first name on the pending list aloud: "Shruti, Rs 2,000." Shruti quietly cuts a number.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom with a money chip
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (first kitty after Diwali) + Admin breaks her own rule (our best hook shape) + Housie money fight

ideas.idea: Hook: Children's Day tiffin kitty, Housie running, Myra pops open a steel school tiffin: "Aaj recess wala lunch!" and Tanya and Shruti hold up theirs (jam bread, Maggi, aloo paratha roll). Context: they swap tiffins like school kids, and Tanya opens hers to find a crushed Parle-G and a juice box when the phone rings: her son on video call from school, holding her kitty paneer tikka, "Mummy, mera tiffin kahan hai?" Ending: split screen, Tanya with the Parle-G, her son happily eating her party starters with his whole class around him.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + call from home
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Children's Day 14 Nov (11 days, +2) + Memory lane kitty

ideas.idea: Dry fruit sorting, blindfolded: each lady gets a steel plate with a mixed fistful of leftover Diwali dry fruits (kaju, badam, kishmish, akhrot, pista) and 5 small katoris. Blindfolded with a dupatta, she has 1 minute to sort them by touch only. Twist: the host secretly mixes in a few peanuts and chana; every one that lands in the kaju katori costs 2 points, and the lowest scorer must bring a dry fruit box to the next kitty. 8 to 20 ladies in rounds of 4 to 5, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: One-minute blindfold challenge in heats
ideas.source: Trend: Post-Diwali dry fruit box glut (Financial Express) + One-minute game

ideas.idea: Regift ki chori: everyone brings one unopened Diwali gift box from home, wrapped in newspaper, with the original gift tag still stuck inside. Chits decide the order; lady 1 opens a gift, every next lady either opens a new one or steals an opened one (a gift can be stolen only twice, then it is locked). Crazy twist: when a gift is opened, the tag is read aloud, so everyone learns whose Diwali gift was passed on and the original giver is often sitting right there. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 to 20 minutes.
ideas.format: Steal-or-open gift swap
ideas.source: Trend: Post-Diwali dry fruit box glut + Cozy pajama winter kitty (regift swap theme, thebash.com)

ideas.idea: Mungfali ginti: a big bowl of roasted peanuts in shells sits in the middle; each lady gets 1 minute and an empty katori to shell as many peanuts as she can, using one hand only. Count the peanuts, not the shells. Crazy twist: the host has hidden 5 peanuts painted with sindoor or food colour in the bowl, and anyone who finds one doubles her count, so the last 10 seconds turn into a dig through the bowl. 8 to 20 ladies in heats, 10 to 15 minutes, chai on the side.
ideas.format: One-minute speed round with a hidden bonus
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty (thebash.com, first cold weeks of November)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running at Tanya's first kitty after Diwali, she waves at her buffet: "Aaj live pasta counter aur sushi!" and the smell of Maggi floats in from the kitchen. Context: on every called number one more lady slips away (Ruhi, then Myra, then Shruti with her ticket) and the chip 'PASTA COUNTER: 0 plates' never moves. Ending: Tanya storms into the kitchen to find all of them crowded round the cook's Maggi pot with steel katoris; she sighs, grabs a katori and holds it out: "Mera bhi ek."
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, living room to kitchen, counter chip, one-pot ending shot (max 3 per shot)
ideas.source: Trend: Maggi counter beats the fancy buffet (republicworld.com, 15M+ views) + LEARNINGS: open on a game in progress

Context: on every number another phone rings ("Namak kahan hai?", "Geyser on nahi ho raha", "Dadi ki dawai?") and each lady answers without looking up while her ticket loses a cut. Ending: all four husbands on one group video call holding the same hissing pressure cooker: "Seeti kitni?" and the whole kitty answers in chorus "Teen!", switches the phones off and cuts the next number.

Context: the two list every function (haldi, sangeet, reception, 'Maggi counter bhi hai') while Tanya pretends not to care and checks her WhatsApp under the table, chip 'CARDS: 13/14'. Ending: Tanya stands up with the kitty diary: "Agli kitty Shaadi theme, 22 November, full lehenga, sangeet bhi!" and both instantly cut their numbers and shout "Main toh aaungi!"
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom + phone card screens, theme announcement ending
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov opens shaadi season (17 days, +2) + Shaadi season kitty + Admin breaks her own rule shape

ideas.idea: Barf mein sikka: the night before, the host freezes 5 Re 1 coins in water in a small steel katori for every lady. In 3 minutes each lady must free as many coins as she can using only her hands and breath (no hot water, no banging on the floor, no teeth). Crazy twist: every 45 seconds the host shouts "Thand!" and everyone passes her half-melted block to the left, so the slow melters get a head start and the fast ones lose their work. Most coins wins. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, keep a towel under each katori.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, frozen katori close-up, the Thand pass twist, rules, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Coins frozen in ice (venuelook.com) + first cold weeks of November

ideas.idea: Sabse common jawab: the host reads 8 household questions every family shouts at mummy ("Kainchi kahan hai?", "Extra chabi?", "Fevicol?", "Thermometer?") and each lady writes where it is in her own house in 10 seconds. Answers are read out and you score one point for every other lady who wrote the same place, so the most common answer wins. Crazy twist: the last question is "Pati ka chashma kahan hai?" and anyone who writes "unke sir pe" gets 5 bonus points. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, only paper and pens.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, sample question slips, scoring example, the chashma twist, winner slide
ideas.source: Trend: Tag your Ghar ki Raunak (our reel, 11 shares) + Multi-character debate (fluxnote.io)

Crazy twist: at 2 minutes the host shouts "Baraat late hai!" and takes one item from every team, and the mandap must still stand for 10 seconds when she drops a bangle on top. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, item tray, build in progress, Baraat late twist, winning mandap
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov (17 days, +2) + Pack in 60 seconds (timed build with household things)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Ruhi's phone pings and she reads the shaadi group out loud: "Sangeet dress code: magenta! Haldi: dusty rose!" Context: Tanya and Myra count their wardrobes on their fingers, "Magenta toh ek hi hai, woh bhi pichli kitty mein pehna tha," chip 'MAGENTA SAREES: 1' changes as each lady admits a repeat, and they all swear to buy a new one. Ending: at the sangeet the three of them walk in wearing the exact same magenta saree from the same kitty sale, freeze, then pose for one group photo.
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, Housie table to sangeet hall, 3 characters, Hinglish, under 30 s; caption names 'the friend who buys the same saree'
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi function colour codes (azafashions.com, Manyavar 2026) + Festival window: shaadi muhurats 21-26 Nov (16 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Shruti slams a sugarcane on the table: "20 ko Dev Uthani, 21 ko Tulsi Vivah, is baar kitty mein hi karenge!" Context: Tanya becomes ladkiwale and Myra ladkewale and they haggle like a real rishta over the shagun (ganna, sindoor, one Housie ticket), chip 'SHAGUN' goes up with each demand. Ending: the gang walks the phere around a tulsi pot under a sugarcane mandap, and Myra stops mid-phera: "Pehle Full House do, phir shaadi!"
ideas.format: Kitty Gang sitcom, living room puja corner with tulsi pot, sugarcane mandap, 3 characters, under 30 s
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Dev Uthani 20 Nov + Tulsi Vivah 21 Nov (15-16 days, +2) + Multi-character debate

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Tina cuts a number and announces: "24 ko kitty cancel, sab Gurpurab pe langar seva!" Context: Tanya reads the seva list and every lady dodges her job ("Main sirf roti belungi, bartan nahi"), chip 'SEVA LIST' fills one name at a time. Ending: at the gurudwara kitchen Tanya, Ruhi and Shruti in dupattas roll rotis in a row, and Shruti still calls Housie numbers from her phone between rotis.

ideas.source: Trend: Gurpurab langar seva (hindupad.com) + Festival window: Gurpurab 24 Nov (19 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Gol roti: pairs share one belan, each lady holding one end with her left hand only, and get 1 minute to roll a ball of atta into a roti on a chakla; the host lays a steel quarter plate on top and the roti that matches the plate edge best wins. Crazy twist: at 30 seconds the host shouts "Langar mein aur log aa gaye!" and every pair must tear its roti in half and roll two small rotis instead. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes, one plate of atta for the whole group.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, belan held by two hands, twist moment, roti under the plate test, winning pair
ideas.source: Trend: Gurpurab langar seva (hindupad.com) + Festival window: Gurpurab 24 Nov (19 days, +2) + One-minute game

ideas.idea: Dress code dhoondo: the host calls a shaadi function and its colour ("Sangeet, magenta!", "Haldi, peela!", "Mehendi, hara!") and every lady has 10 seconds to hold up something of that colour from her bag, outfit or the room; the last one or anyone without it is out. Crazy twist: on "Rishtedaar aa gaye!" every lady must swap dupattas or stoles with the lady on her right and keep playing in them. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, colour call list, ladies holding up items, dupatta swap twist, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi function colour codes (azafashions.com) + Festival window: shaadi muhurats 21-26 Nov (16 days, +2)

ideas.idea: Rajai mein kya hai: the host hides 10 household things under a thick rajai on the sofa (comb, lemon, remote, bangle, matchbox, steel spoon, safety pin box, sock, hair clip, tea strainer). Each lady gets 30 seconds to feel through the rajai without lifting it, then writes her list; most right answers wins. Crazy twist: one thing is a zip bag of ice cubes and whoever names it first gets double points, but the host swaps two items while the next lady is feeling. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 to 20 minutes.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, rajai on sofa, hands feeling through, answer sheet, the reveal
ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty + Coins frozen in ice (first cold weeks of November)

ideas.idea: Hook: Housie running, Tanya sets a huge kadhai on the table: "Pehli thand, pehla gajar ka halwa!" Context: on every called number Ruhi and Myra argue whose saas makes it better ("Khoya daalo!", "Condensed milk se hi banta hai!") while sneaking extra spoons, chip 'HALWA KATORIS: 14' dropping each beat. Ending: Shruti claims Full House and, offered the cash envelope or the last katori, grabs the katori; Ruhi and Myra stare at the empty kadhai.
ideas.format: Housie-in-progress sitcom, living room, kadhai and katori chip, 3 characters per shot, Hinglish, under 30 s; caption 'Tag the friend jo halwa ke liye kitty bhi chhod de'
ideas.source: Trend: First winter spread: gajar halwa and sarson saag (republicworld.com) + LEARNINGS: open on a game in progress, visible stake chip

Context: every time she gets to the juicy part something cuts her off (a number she must cut, the chai tray, Shruti's phone ringing), and Tanya and Myra lean closer each time, chip 'GOSSIP: 90% loading'. Ending: she finally opens her mouth and the doorbell rings; the lady she was talking about walks in, and all three loudly cut numbers. Text: 'Part 2?'

ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty + first cold weeks of November + LEARNINGS: open on the game, stake chip changes every shot

ideas.idea: Thand ka parcel: wrap a small prize in 10 layers, and inside each layer put one winter thing (sock, muffler, monkey cap, gloves, shawl, ear muffs). Pass it to music; when the music stops the holder opens one layer and must wear what she finds for the rest of the game, even a sock on her hand. Crazy twist: when the host shouts "Heater on!" everyone must take off one worn item and put it on the lady to her right. 8 to 20 ladies, 15 minutes.

ideas.source: Trend: Cozy pajama winter kitty + Ugly sweater winter party + first cold weeks of November

Crazy twist: before the game the host gives one secret chit "Story palat do", and that lady must flip the story with a plot twist; at the end everyone guesses who the twister was. 8 to 20 ladies, 10 to 15 minutes, only chits.
ideas.format: Carousel: game card, sample story chain, the secret chit, guess-the-twister slide, winner
ideas.source: Trend: Micro-drama cliffhanger (Meta-Ormax report) + Multi-character debate (fluxnote.io)

ideas.idea: Thekua stamp: each lady gets a lemon-sized ball of atta dough, a steel plate and one household tool (fork, comb, bottle cap, toothpick) and has 1 minute to press the prettiest Chhath thekua pattern. Crazy twist: at 30 seconds the host shouts "Tool badlo!" and everyone passes her tool to the right and finishes with the new one.
